subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is 陈千语 in <Picture 1>; preserve her face, dark hair, horns, tail, and blue outfit.
<Subject 2> is 佩丽卡 in <Picture 2>; preserve her face, pale hair, feather-like ears, and white outfit.
<Subject 3> is the courtyard in <Picture 3>, with a central sinkhole, broken concrete, pink barriers, warning tape, pipes, cliffs, and orange gantry.
<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S1); delivery changes from feigned concern to frightened hesitation.
<Audio 2> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 2> (S2); target delivery is angry, independent of source emotion.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] In <Subject 3>, 佩丽卡 inspects the sinkhole. 陈千语 passes, initiating an exchange that becomes an angry confrontation and frightened response. <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> define identities; <Audio 1> and <Audio 2> guide voices.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 2], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - identity and costume.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - identity and costume.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): partially_preserved - retain layout; use cel-shaded 3D without readable signs or interface overlays.
<Audio 1>: reference - retain voice identity; reperform both lines with their respective emotions, without copying source speech.
<Audio 2>: reference - retain voice identity; reperform the supplied line angrily, without copying source speech.

detailed_description:
Stylized 3D animation with a 2D cel-shaded finish, stable outlines, stepped shadows, controlled highlights, and coherent volume and motion. Cool daylight lights the grey courtyard with consistent shadows. Characters never look into the camera. No on-screen text.
[Shot 1] From intact pavement behind 佩丽卡, a rear medium-wide shot faces the central sinkhole in <Subject 3>. She stands centered on solid ground outside the warning tape at the near rim, back to camera, hands lowered, head slightly bowed, looking into the hole. Perform a slow Hitchcock dolly zoom: push toward her while zooming out, keeping her upper body nearly constant in size as the background stretches in perspective. Wind moves her hair tips; machinery hums.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, cut to a medium two-shot from behind and slightly to 佩丽卡's right. The hole remains ahead. 陈千语 enters screen right, walking leftward on safe pavement behind the rim. She slows a pace behind and to the right, looks at the bowed figure, and gives a small greeting gesture. 陈千语 (S1), using <Audio 1>'s voice identity, puts on a polite smile and speaks with hesitant, falsely caring cheerfulness; voice the written chuckle naturally: <d>[Chinese] 呃，嘿嘿，总督今天忙呢。</d> Her hand lowers and her steps stop. 佩丽卡's shoulders tense as the line ends.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, cut to a rear-right three-quarter medium close shot of 佩丽卡. She sharply turns her head and upper torso over her right shoulder toward the passerby, feet planted. Her hair and jacket lag with inertia. Simultaneously push in extremely fast, reaching a tight three-quarter facial close-up within half a second. Her face angles beside the lens; her angry sideways gaze fixes on 陈千语 off-screen. 佩丽卡 (S2), using <Audio 2>'s voice identity, knits her brows, tightens her jaw, and demands angrily, briefly pausing after the opening words: <d>[Chinese] 你说，那个秦江尺，是不是贪了不少？</d> Her lips close, her glare unbroken.
[Shot 4] At 00:11.500, cut to a reverse close-up of 陈千语 from near the listener's right shoulder, preserving the dialogue axis and daylight direction. She looks just off-camera toward 佩丽卡, momentarily blank and a little frightened. Her smile vanishes; her eyes widen slightly, shoulders draw inward, and lower lip trembles. 陈千语 (S1), retaining <Audio 1>'s voice identity, answers quietly in an unsteady voice, hesitating after the first word and trailing off weakly: <d>[Chinese] 呃，可能吧...</d> She closes her lips, keeping her timid gaze on the listener. End at 15.00 seconds.

overall_soundscape:
Light wind and distant ventilation continue beneath gritty footsteps, clothing rustle during the turn, and faint nervous breathing. Footsteps stop before the confrontation. No dramatic stinger.
